title: A payment taken with no internet from the Dues list only says "Payment saved."
what: From a member's page, a payment taken with no internet says it is saved on this device, gives its receipt number and says it goes online later. The same payment taken from the Dues list in Money says only "Payment saved.", with no receipt number and no word that it is still only on this device.
expected: The Dues list gives the same message as the member page: saved on this device, the receipt number, and that it goes online when the internet is back.
how_often: every payment taken from the Dues list while the internet is off
fix_line: Use the member page's message, with the receipt number, on the Dues list too

title: The desk sees an empty "Pay online" box when the gym has no UPI ID
what: In a gym with no UPI ID and no payment company, a desk login that opens Collect payment or Sell membership sees a box headed "Pay online" with nothing in it. The owner sees a line telling them to add the UPI ID; the desk gets no words and no button.
expected: The box is hidden for the desk when there is nothing to offer, or says in one line that the owner can switch this on in Settings.
who: desk staff of gyms with no UPI ID saved
how_often: every time such a desk opens a money sheet for ₹1 or more
fix_line: Hide the box for the desk when there is no UPI ID and no payment company

title: The owner is told "The owner gives the extra days." when the member has no plan to add days to
what: After checking a workout code, the owner should get a "Give extra days" button. When the member has no gym plan that can take days (only a personal-training pack, or every plan cancelled), the owner instead reads "The owner gives the extra days.", the line meant for the desk, and has no button and no reason.
expected: The owner is told why no days can be given (the member has no plan to add them to) and what to do, such as sell or restore a plan first.
how_often: each time a workout code is checked for a member with check-ins but no gym plan that is not cancelled
fix_line: Give the owner their own line that says the member needs a plan first
